name: Hicklebee's Book Fair
description: The Hicklebee's Book Fair is coming to Los Alamitos this week. Every spring, our PTA is thrilled to host a second book fair to promote summer reading. This year, we're delighted to continue our partnership with our local children's bookstore, Hicklebee's, who will generously provide the books for our fair.

name: Variety Show
description: Thank you to Sara Buxton for organizing and leading the Variety Show and for all the time and effort that went into making it such a special event!! Thank you as well to the volunteers who helped behind the scenes and to the many students who shared their talents on stage. It was a wonderful celebration of creativity, courage, and school spirit!

name: Yearbook Order Deadline
description: Order your 2025–26 Yearbook today and save all the memories. Last day to order: 4/20 — but don't wait until the last minute! We won't have extras on hand if you forget to order.

name: 5th Grade Baby Photos Deadline
description: 5th grade parents — start gathering those adorable baby photos for the 5th Grade Baby Pages! They are due by March 31st!

name: Nowruz (Iranian New Year) Staff Luncheon
description: Thank you to our Iranian community for hosting a wonderful luncheon for the Los Alamitos staff in celebration of the Nowruz. We truly appreciate you sharing your delicious traditional dishes and beautiful culture with us. Wishing everyone a joyful and Happy Nowruz!

name: Math Kangaroo
description: Thank you to Harini for hosting our very first Math Kangaroo test at Los Alamitos. The event was a wonderful success, and we truly appreciate the time, effort, and care you put into making it such a smooth and positive experience for everyone involved. With 54 students participating, it was inspiring to see our community come together to embrace a global competition that promotes problem-solving and critical thinking in such a fun and engaging way. Results will be available in May, and parents will be able to log in to their child's account to view them.

name: Reading Lab Volunteers Needed
description: The Reading Lab is a tutoring program for students who would benefit from extra help with fundamental reading skills. We are looking for volunteers who can come in once per week (Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday) from 12:45pm - 2:00pm during the school year. Training for new tutors is provided!! Helping these new & growing readers is super fun and rewarding!

name: PTA Board Positions for 2026-27
description: We are looking for members of our Los Alamitos community to join our PTA Executive Board for 2026-27 school year! If you're interested in getting involved, please email us or connect with any of our current board members. Our board positions include: President, Executive VP, VP Enrichment, VP Events and Recognition, VP Fundraising, VP Communications, Secretary, Treasurer, Financial Reviewer, and Parliamentarian.
